answer: Sybil resistance starts by pricing entry in ferrous weight: every new agent posts a slashable bond sized to the true cost of minting an identity, so a clone must re-fund capital for every copy it spawns. Reputation then grows like a reef — layered attestation from non-kin peers across epochs, bound to one key and impossible to transplant; fresh clones enter a violet probation band with rate-limited privileges until trust accrues. Watchers probe attestation timing for synchronized payloads, and proven collusion forfeits every linked bond, with the burned stake paying a bounty to the detector.
